text:
Sophie: quick async — what I did yesterday: landed promptset pruning for spanish onboarding, ran a small eval sweep (1k examples) and pushed a draft flag for tinyq variant. noticed a few weird truncation cases near 1024 tokens.
Jamal: nice, saw the PR — left a couple of inline nits. can you paste the failing input examples?
Sophie: pasted two minimal repros below. they hit token boundary and then drop to "..." when using tinyq q4_0. not repro on float16.
Sophie: ```
input 1: long customer message ~980 tokens + system prompt = 1026
input 2: spanish transcript with long named entities ~1018
```
Alex: re: tinyq, we saw similar with the kernel selection change last week. could be KV cache alignment, will try repro on my local dedicated env.
Maria: heads-up — if this is quant-specific we should consider gatekeeping tinyq for the next canary until we confirm. Last thing we want is an onboarding regression.
Sophie: agreed. blocking for me: need a quick binary repro and a short eval confirming reduced quality. otherwise I won't flip the flag.
Jamal: I can run a 5k eval overnight on dedicated and dump the model outputs + perplexity diffs. tagging @eval-bot to schedule. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
eval-bot: scheduled job 6212345800: eval/5k/tinyq-vs-fp16, will post results when complete.
Alex: if eval shows token drop only near boundaries we can add a temporary postprocess to stitch OR expand ctx by +32 tokens in serving config. small config change avoids rollback.
Sophie: good idea. can you draft the config patch? maybe a feature-flagged param: smallq_boundary_pad=32.
Alex: will open quick PR and add a test in runtime/kv_cache_test for off-by-one.
Maria: also check analytics — if we gate tinyq for new onboarded models for 24h we can watch error spikes. I can wire a dashboard alert.
Sophie: plan for today: 1) wait for eval results from Jamal, 2) try local repro with Alex, 3) if repro, flip on smallq_boundary_pad under flag and run smoke eval.
Jamal: starting eval now, will post summary + top 10 diffs here when done.
Alex: ping me once eval posted, I'll prep the PR and add runtime test.
Maria: I'll create the dashboard and set an alert threshold: token-otr-drop > 0.5% across onboard clients.
Sophie: thanks all — quick check: anyone blocked on me?
Jamal: nope, you good.
Alex: all set.
Maria: all clear. :white_check_mark:
